faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Hyderabad is 19th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is MTech. in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, or equivalent; or M.Sc. in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, or equivalent; or MS (Pharma) with at least 70% marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 36,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How is the selection process conducted for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit and relevant experience, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job offered?
faq.answer: The job offered is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad is located in Sangareddy, Telangana, with the pincode 502285.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit restrictions for the applicants?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any minimum or maximum age limits for the applicants. It is advisable to check the official notification for detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Hyderabad. The application link and other important details are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
